The issue proposes invalidProperties for both-set and for a value not in workflowStatuses, and leaves open: mirror an RFC 8984 value into progress, or drop the MUST-null rule. Needs Mark's pick.\nMark 2026-11-19, decision 42: mirror. Standard RFC 8984 value in workflowStatus -\u003e server sets progress (and progressUpdated) to it; other values -\u003e progress null. progress set to a different value alongside workflowStatus -\u003e invalidProperties; workflowStatus not in the list's workflowStatuses -\u003e invalidProperties; list workflowStatuses changes leave tasks alone; a move to a list lacking the value -\u003e invalidProperties naming workflowStatus unless the update also sets one the list has or null. Unblocked."}
